title: Ordinary higher direct images are quasi-coherent
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ [pqf-def-coherent] and every $p\in\mathbf N$, the ordinary higher direct image $R^pf_*M$ is quasi-coherent. Here the ordinary higher image is the $p$-th right derived functor of module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], not the higher image of an arbitrary derived object.

proof.text: Supply the Grothendieck abelian structure on X.Modules, hence injective resolutions, and register the given quasi-coherence of M. Apply the already stated ordinary higher-image theorem [lem-pc-sections-higher-direct-image-quasi-coherent]. Its higherDirectImage is definitionally the right derived RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage appearing in this statement. The existing theorem is proved by the two localization criteria on affine opens, not by this node.

proof_origin.place: Part (1); second reader X3 reuses the existing localization-criterion proof in DirectImage.Sections

theorem ordinaryHigherImage_isQuasicoherent
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (p : ℕ) :
    SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u}
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M)
lean.note: Reuses the existing ordinary higher-image quasi-coherence theorem in DirectImage.Sections. Its current localization proof has no import cycle through this module.
